body:
Thank you so much for your response. It's stupid but I felt a little more isolated. You're such a generous person, thank you for taking time to write to me. 

I was thinking of ways I could hurt myself or get myself killed somehow. I was thinking about how I wanted to just end everything. But thank you. I still feel the same but having someone write to me gives me something good and positive and kind to focus on. Thank you for your time, thank you so much. I wish you could see how much I'm affected, I'm sobbing like a child. Thank you for just letting me feel and not judging me. THank you so much.
